en: The pagoda seems to spring forth from the earth, standing lonely and high, towering over the heavenly palace.

en: Its abrupt height dominates the Divine Land; its steep grandeur looks like the work of spirits.

t: 四角礙白日，七層摩蒼穹。
c: 四角碍白日，七层摩苍穹。

en: Its four corners obstruct the bright sun; its seven stories scrape the blue dome of heaven.

t: 下窺指高鳥，俯聽聞驚風。
c: 下窥指高鸟，俯听闻惊风。
p: Xià kuī zhǐ gāo niǎo, fǔ tīng wén jīng fēng.

en: Peering down, we point at the birds flying high; bending to listen, we hear the startling wind.

t: 連山若波濤，奔走似朝東。
c: 连山若波涛，奔走似朝东。
p: Lián shān ruò bō tāo, bēn zǒu sì cháo dōng.

en: The continuous mountains look like surging waves, running as if rushing eastward.

t: 青槐夾馳道，宮館何玲瓏。
c: 青槐夹驰道，宫馆何玲珑。
p: Qīng huái jiā chí dào, gōng guǎn hé líng lóng.

en: Green locust trees line the imperial road; how exquisite and intricate the palaces appear!

t: 秋色從西來，蒼然滿關中。
c: 秋色从西来，苍然满关中。

en: Autumn colors arrive from the west, filling the Pass with a vast, gray haze.

t: 五陵北原上，萬古青濛濛。
c: 五陵北原上，万古青蒙蒙。
p: Wǔ líng běi yuán shàng, wàn gǔ qīng méng méng.

en: Upon the northern plain of the Five Mausoleums, an eternal green mist hangs hazily.

t: 淨理了可悟，勝因夙所宗。
c: 净理了可悟，胜因夙所宗。
p: Jìng lǐ liǎo kě wù, shèng yīn sù suǒ zōng.

en: The pure truth of Buddhism can be fully realized here; the excellent karma is what I have long revered.

t: 誓將掛冠去，覺道資無窮。
c: 誓将挂冠去，觉道资无穷。
p: Shì jiāng guà guān qù, jué dào zī wú qióng.

en: I vow to hang up my official cap and leave, for the path of enlightenment offers infinite resources.
